'''Brrazz''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] active during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Brrazz appears in the [[February]] [[2022]] Game Update 7.0 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
